testimonials.visible.label: Show this page to visitors
testimonials.visible.hint: Off, and the testimonials page disappears from the menu and answers Not Found for everybody except you. Useful while it is still being written.

testimonials.name.visible.label: Show who said it
testimonials.name.visible.hint: Off, and every quote is anonymous: on this page, the home page, the coaching page, the about page and the course cards.

testimonials.firstName.visible.label: First names only
testimonials.firstName.visible.hint: On, and somebody who left their full name appears by their first name alone, wherever they are quoted.

testimonials.company.visible.label: Show where they work
testimonials.company.visible.hint: Where they work, after their job title, wherever they are quoted.

testimonials.meta.description.value: What people say about the courses, coaching and training here.
testimonials.meta.description.label: Search description
testimonials.meta.description.hint: The sentence Google shows under the page title in search results. Around 150 to 160 characters; longer is cut off mid-word.

testimonials.meta.titlePrefix.label: Browser tab and search result title
testimonials.meta.titlePrefix.hint: What comes before the business name in the browser tab and in a search result. The page name on its own is fine; something a person would search for is better.

testimonials.hero.heading.label: Hero heading
testimonials.hero.heading.hint: The pale hero above the quotes

testimonials.hero.intro.value: Real feedback from professionals who have attended our courses and coaching programmes.
testimonials.hero.intro.label: Hero introduction
testimonials.hero.intro.hint: The pale hero above the quotes

testimonials.hero.reviewsSuffix.label: Rating suffix
testimonials.hero.reviewsSuffix.hint: The pale hero above the quotes. Reads "from 24 reviews"; the number comes from the database

testimonials.hero.from.label: Before the number of reviews
testimonials.hero.from.hint: The pale hero above the quotes. Reads "from 24 reviews"

testimonials.hero.outOf.label: After a rating
testimonials.hero.outOf.hint: Follows the average rating in the hero and the score on each quote, as in "9.4/10"

testimonials.grid.search.label: Search box
testimonials.grid.search.hint: Shown faintly in the empty search box above the quotes

testimonials.grid.allCourses.label: Every course choice
testimonials.grid.allCourses.hint: The first choice in the course filter, which shows every quote

testimonials.grid.allRatings.label: Every rating choice
testimonials.grid.allRatings.hint: The first choice in the rating filter, which shows every quote

testimonials.grid.starsSuffix.label: After the number in the rating choices
testimonials.grid.starsSuffix.hint: Reads "9+ Stars". Keep the plus sign if you want it to say "or more"

testimonials.grid.featured.label: Featured label
testimonials.grid.featured.hint: The small tag on a quote marked as featured

testimonials.grid.readMore.label: Read more
testimonials.grid.readMore.hint: After a long quote that has been shortened

testimonials.grid.showLess.label: Show less
testimonials.grid.showLess.hint: After a long quote once it has been opened up

testimonials.grid.viewOriginal.label: Link to the original
testimonials.grid.viewOriginal.hint: On a quote that came from somewhere else, such as LinkedIn

testimonials.grid.noMatch.value: No testimonials found matching your filters.
testimonials.grid.noMatch.label: Nothing matches
testimonials.grid.noMatch.hint: Shown when the search or filters leave no quotes

testimonials.grid.empty.value: Nobody has left a testimonial yet.
testimonials.grid.empty.label: No quotes yet
testimonials.grid.empty.hint: Shown in place of the quotes until the first one is approved
